title: Kerala School Sasthrolsavam Manual 2019, hosted by the official 2024 portal
pages: 168 PDF pages; cover, foreword, order PDF p. 5, general PDF p. 11 and Science PDF pp. 42–48 visually inspected
notes: Cover identifies 2019; hosting directory does not date the document. G.O.(Ms)119/2019/GEDN dated 8 August 2019 appears on PDF p. 5. Printed body page +8 generally gives PDF page. HS Working Model already requires two pupils on printed p. 35. Older general and Science UP progression clauses conflict.

title: General Education Department publication of the revised Sasthrolsavam Manual 2025
pages: 250 PDF pages; publication cover extracted and cross-checked with the KITE-hosted compiled manual
notes: DGE order Y1/7858/2024/DGE dated 12 September 2025 cites G.O.146/2025/GEDN of 23 August 2025, G.O.118/2024/GEDN of 20 September 2024 and G.O.116/2024/GEDN of 19 September 2024. Downloaded 3,446,581 bytes, SHA256 12a132b7ca95954f9f290eda4a131611cde3769b23081ab91c7154416c054fd3. Different public file size from KITE copy; no claim of byte identity. Detailed current rule references use rules-manual-2025.

title: G.O.(Ms)146/2025/GEDN, government-order copy on a third-party mirror
pages: 35 PDF pages; cover and Science PDF pp. 2–8, Social Science pp. 29–30, Work Experience pp. 34–35 inspected
notes: 418,381-byte PDF downloaded. Identifier/date match references in the official compiled 2025 manual. Third-party watermark; original government-hosted standalone order not recovered. Read amended right column rather than existing left column. Current rules cross-checked against official compiled manual.

title: G.O.(Ms)116/2024/GEDN and Work Experience annex, mirrored copy
pages: Two PDF pages; cover and annex visually inspected
notes: 683,414-byte PDF downloaded. Official compiled 2025 manual cites this order. Work Experience removals/additions differ between LP/UP and HS/HSS/VHSS. Agarbathi and Umbrella deletions are in the latter section, so retained LP codes 216 and 237 are not contradictions. Original government-hosted standalone order not recovered.

title: Manual and 2025 government-order download discovery page
notes: Opened to locate the downloadable G.O.146/2025 copy. Page path dates do not date every linked update. The blog's prose is not used as authority for competition rules.

title: 2024 Work Experience order and revised manual download discovery page
notes: Opened to locate G.O.116/2024, its annex and a revised Work Experience manual. The linked order was downloaded and visually inspected separately; the index is not rule authority.

notes: Opened Science rows. HS Working Model 115 and HSS Working Model 126 are G/max2; historical Science quiz rows S/max1. This corroborates a historical group capacity but the manual establishes the required pupil count. Generic state templates do not establish level eligibility.
